description: This Java class 'MidiPortWrapper' provides a wrapper around MIDI device and port descriptions, encapsulating device information and port attributes, with methods for comparison, string representation, and internal data management.

classes.name: MidiPortWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that encapsulates a MIDI device and port description, providing methods to access and compare MIDI port details.

methods.name: MidiPortWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with device info, port type, and port index.

methods.name: updateString
methods.description: Updates the string representation of the MIDI port information based on current device info and port details.

methods.name: findPortInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the specific PortInfo object matching the stored port index and type.

methods.name: getPortIndex
methods.description: Returns the port index associated with this wrapper.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the MIDI port, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this MidiPortWrapper with another object for equality based on device info, port index, and port type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on port index, port type, and device info.
